bubble_trigger_label.description: Accessible label of the small floating TransPop button shown next to selected text

bubble_trigger_hint.description: Tooltip of the floating button; $1 = modifier key name, e.g. Shift

bubble_dialog_label.description: Accessible name of the translation bubble (role=dialog)

bubble_listen_source.description: Speaker button next to the selected (source) text

bubble_expand_source.description: Expands the clamped (3-line) source text in the bubble header

bubble_collapse_source.description: Collapses the expanded source text in the bubble header

bubble_translate_into.description: Label of the target-language dropdown in the bubble

bubble_no_translation.description: Shown when the provider returned an empty translation

bubble_crop_overlay_label.description: Accessible name of the full-screen area-selection overlay (image translation)

bubble_crop_hint.en: Drag to select an area · Esc to cancel
bubble_crop_hint.vi: Kéo để chọn vùng · Esc để hủy
bubble_crop_hint.description: Hint in the toolbar at the top of the area-selection overlay

bubble_crop_image_missing.en: Couldn't find the image — drag to select it · Esc to cancel
bubble_crop_image_missing.vi: Không tìm thấy ảnh — hãy kéo để chọn · Esc để hủy
bubble_crop_image_missing.description: Overlay hint when "Translate text in image" can't locate the right-clicked image

bubble_crop_full.vi: Dùng toàn bộ phần trang đang hiển thị
bubble_crop_full.description: Icon button in the overlay toolbar: recognize text in the whole visible area instead of dragging

bubble_crop_langs_label.vi: Ngôn ngữ của chữ (để nhận dạng)
bubble_crop_langs_label.description: Label of the OCR language picker (languages written in the image, up to 3)

bubble_crop_lang_add.description: Dropdown that adds an OCR language (shown as a small + button)

bubble_crop_lang_remove.description: Remove button on an OCR language chip; $1 = language name

bubble_crop_dialog_label.description: Accessible name of the image-translation results bubble

bubble_crop_title.description: Title of the image-translation results bubble

bubble_crop_slow.en: The first time a language is used, its data (a few MB) is downloaded — this can take a moment.
bubble_crop_slow.vi: Lần đầu dùng một ngôn ngữ cần tải dữ liệu của nó (vài MB) — có thể mất một lúc.
bubble_crop_slow.description: Extra hint when OCR takes more than a few seconds

bubble_crop_auto.description: Small pill before the OCR language chips: the text language is detected automatically

bubble_crop_auto_title.en: The text language is detected from the page automatically — the languages shown are tried too.
bubble_crop_auto_title.vi: Ngôn ngữ của chữ được tự nhận diện từ trang — các ngôn ngữ hiển thị ở đây cũng được thử.

bubble_crop_no_text_with.en: No text found with: $1. Is the text in another language?
bubble_crop_no_text_with.vi: Không tìm thấy chữ khi đọc bằng: $1. Chữ có phải là ngôn ngữ khác không?
bubble_crop_no_text_with.description: OCR found nothing; $1 = the languages that were tried, e.g. "English" or "Chinese (Simplified) and English". Followed by one-tap language buttons

bubble_crop_try_label.description: Accessible name of the group of language buttons shown after "No text found"

bubble_crop_try_lang.description: Tooltip of a language button after "No text found"; the button shows the language's own name, $1 = its name in the UI language

bubble_crop_more_langs.description: Dropdown after the quick language buttons: pick any other OCR language

bubble_crop_more_langs_label.vi: Chọn ngôn ngữ khác của chữ
bubble_crop_more_langs_label.description: Accessible name / tooltip of the More… dropdown

bubble_crop_downloading.en: Downloading language data the first time…
bubble_crop_downloading.vi: Đang tải dữ liệu ngôn ngữ (chỉ lần đầu)…
bubble_crop_downloading.description: Shown while OCR retries with a newly chosen language

bubble_crop_recognized_label.vi: Chữ nhận dạng được (có thể sửa)
bubble_crop_recognized_label.description: Label of the editable textarea with the OCR result

bubble_crop_low_confidence.en: The text may not be recognized accurately — check it and edit if needed.
bubble_crop_low_confidence.vi: Chữ có thể chưa được nhận dạng chính xác — hãy kiểm tra và sửa nếu cần.
bubble_crop_low_confidence.description: Note under the recognized text when OCR confidence is low

bubble_crop_translate_again_hint.description: Tooltip of "Translate again"; $1 = keyboard shortcut, e.g. Ctrl + Enter

bubble_crop_select_again.description: Button: take a new screenshot and select another area

bubble_crop_listen_text.description: Speaker button under the recognized text

bubble_crop_copy_text.vi: Sao chép chữ nhận dạng được
bubble_crop_copy_text.description: Copy button under the recognized text
